# Notes.ThatVetGuy

> Free academic resources, thoughtfully made for future vets.

A free academic library for BVSc & AH students. Site summaries: Dr. Chirag Patidar, BVSc & AH, MVSc. Notes, books and practical material are organised by professional year and subject. File links open on Google Drive. Known source credits are preserved; inclusion does not imply authorship or medical review.

Main website: https://thatvetguy.net
Author: Dr. Chirag Patidar
Last source review: 2026-10-18. File access settings can change.

## Sections and subject guides

- [Free Veterinary Notes, Books & Study Resources | ThatVetGuy](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/): Free academic resources, thoughtfully made for future vets. Find BVSc & AH notes, books, objective questions and clinical references by year.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/index.md
- [BVSc Notes & Books](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/): Recommended books, topic-wise notes and roadmaps for BVSc & AH. Choose a subject to open its section in the right year.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/index.md
- [1st Year BVSc Books, Notes & Roadmaps](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-1/): 1st Year BVSc & AH books, topic-wise notes and study roadmaps, organised by subject. Start with your subject and get straight to the reading.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-1/index.md
- [1st Year Topic-wise BVSc Notes](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-1/notes/): Topic-wise 1st Year BVSc & AH notes, grouped by subject and unit. Pick a subject below or search for the topic you need.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-1/notes/index.md
- [2nd Year BVSc Books, Notes & Roadmaps](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/): 2nd Year BVSc & AH books, topic-wise notes and study roadmaps, organised by subject. Start with your subject and get straight to the reading.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/index.md
- [2nd Year Topic-wise BVSc Notes](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/notes/): Topic-wise 2nd Year BVSc & AH notes, grouped by subject and unit. Pick a subject below or search for the topic you need.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/notes/index.md
- [3rd Year BVSc Books, Notes & Roadmaps](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/): 3rd Year BVSc & AH books, topic-wise notes and study roadmaps, organised by subject. Start with your subject and get straight to the reading.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/index.md
- [3rd Year Topic-wise BVSc Notes](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/notes/): Topic-wise 3rd Year BVSc & AH notes, grouped by subject and unit. Pick a subject below or search for the topic you need.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/notes/index.md
- [4th Year BVSc Books, Notes & Roadmaps](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-4/): 4th Year BVSc & AH books, topic-wise notes and study roadmaps, organised by subject. Start with your subject and get straight to the reading.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-4/index.md
- [4th Year Topic-wise BVSc Notes](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-4/notes/): Topic-wise 4th Year BVSc & AH notes, grouped by subject and unit. Pick a subject below or search for the topic you need.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-4/notes/index.md
- [Objective & Competition Resources](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/objective/): Objective notes and veterinary question banks for BVSc & AH revision. Browse Dhruv N Desai, Animal Science Refresher, TANUVAS and more, with direct Telegram access.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/objective/index.md
- [Clinical Resources](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/clinical/): Veterinary handbooks and pharmacology notes for students preparing for clinical work. Start with a reference or explore Medicine, Surgery, Pathology and Pharmacology.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/clinical/index.md
- [Tips & Tools for Vet Study](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/study-tools/): Explore practical AI study guidance, useful free apps and everyday study tools for veterinary students. Use the guides to organise reading, references and presentations while checking veterinary information against trusted sources.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/study-tools/index.md
- [About Notes.ThatVetGuy](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/about/): Notes.ThatVetGuy is a free academic library for BVSc & AH students. Find notes, books and practical material by year, with study guides to help you choose what to read next.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/about/index.md
- [Request a Resource](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/request-resource/): Request a veterinary note, book, PYQ or useful study resource, or report a link that needs attention. Include the subject, year and source so the library can be improved for other veterinary students.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/request-resource/index.md
- [Handbooks Collection](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/clinical/handbooks/): Veterinary handbook material in one place for BVSc & AH students. Check the original edition and use clinical references alongside supervised training.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/clinical/handbooks/index.md
- [Drug Index Collection](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/clinical/drug-index/): Veterinary drug indexes, a drug handbook, a wall reference and vaccination schedules in one collection. Open a resource in Telegram and check its edition before clinical use.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/clinical/drug-index/index.md
